answers.rationale: The award_remaining_balance relation for A-101 records award_amount 50000, disbursed_total 35000, and remaining_balance 15000.
For A-102 (SEED-FAST), award_match_obligation establishes match_required no and match_rate 0, so no cash match is required.
award_status_label interprets status_code A as Active for A-101 and A-102. A-104 and A-105 have uninterpreted status codes; A-103 is Closed.

A-101 is SEED-CORE with match_rate 0.20, but purpose_requirement_failure records seed_core_waiver_unknown for A-101 on award_match_obligation because the packet lacks waiver letters, so the required cash-match amount cannot be established confidently.

A-104 carries status_code S, which is absent from status_legend_entry and flagged by purpose_requirement_failure (status_code_not_in_legend and award_status_interpretable UNINTERPRETED), so its meaning is not established.
purpose_requirement_failure records seed_core_waiver_unknown for A-105 (SEED-CORE) as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED because the packet does not attach waiver letters, so waiver status cannot be determined.
